datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data on a monthly schedule (January and February 2022 shown) across Yemen administrative units. The data represents medium-term projections of acute food insecurity phases, classified according to the IPC scale and aggregated geographically to produce spatial datasets of food security impact.
